title: Revit Graphics Control Fields

entries.name: Graphics control level
entries.requirement: Each governed graphics rule shall identify whether its baseline authority belongs to Object Styles, a view template, a rule-based filter, a material, or another governed control layer.

entries.name: Category or subcategory scope
entries.requirement: The rule shall identify the applicable Revit category or approved subcategory scope without relying on ambiguous free text.

entries.name: Display context
entries.requirement: Where graphics vary by view type, purpose, discipline or output context, the applicable context shall be declared explicitly.

entries.name: Projection graphics
entries.requirement: Where governed, projection line weight, pattern and color values shall be stored as explicit configuration values or references rather than inferred from examples.

entries.name: Cut graphics
entries.requirement: Where governed, cut line weight, pattern and color values shall be stored as explicit configuration values or references rather than inferred from examples.

entries.name: Fill or hatch basis
entries.requirement: Where a fill or hatch is governed, the approved pattern identity, pattern type and applicable scale/density basis shall be traceable.

entries.name: Rule-based filter logic
entries.requirement: Condition-based graphics that recur across views shall identify the governed filter logic or registry reference that implements the semantic rule.

entries.name: Approved subcategory identity
entries.requirement: Reusable family/detail graphics shall use stable approved subcategory identities; project-specific duplicates or near-duplicates shall not be treated as governed values.

entries.name: Print/legibility validation
entries.requirement: Graphics values intended for documentation shall identify the applicable validation basis for legibility at governed output scales or plotting conditions.

entries.name: Change-control trace
entries.requirement: Changes to governed graphics definitions shall be traceable to the standards/template release process rather than made as unrecorded project-local changes.

non_promoted_source_content: The source line-weight examples such as Walls 2/5 and Structural Framing 3/5 are not promoted as enterprise defaults because the source explicitly says they require confirmation against plotting tests.
Example subcategory names such as DET_BOUNDARY, DET_HATCH, DET_CENTERLINE and DET_PIPING are not promoted as approved enterprise vocabulary until a governed subcategory catalogue exists.
Example hatch names, RGB values and plotting assumptions remain source examples or TODO-bound values.

provenance.source_title: Category & Subcategory Graphics Standards and Guidelines
provenance.migration_note: Migrated the machine-readable graphics-control fields and authority hierarchy while preserving unresolved numeric style values as project/template configuration rather than enterprise doctrine.
